parameters.name: Fuel Flow Rate
parameters.description: Anode fuel inlet volumetric flow rate.

parameters.name: Air Flow Rate
parameters.description: Cathode air inlet volumetric flow rate.

parameters.name: Steam-to-Carbon Ratio
parameters.description: Steam-to-carbon ratio for hydrocarbon fuels (ignored for pure H2).

parameters.name: Load Ramp Rate
parameters.description: Rate of load change during ramps.

parameters.name: Dwell at Max Load
parameters.description: Dwell duration at maximum load during cycles.

parameters.name: TPB Density
parameters.description: Triple-phase boundary density (surface per volume proxy).

parameters.name: Anode Ionic Conductivity
parameters.description: Effective ionic conductivity of YSZ in anode.

parameters.name: Anode Electronic Conductivity
parameters.description: Effective electronic conductivity via Ni network.

parameters.name: Cathode Ionic Conductivity
parameters.description: Effective ionic conductivity (if composite with GDC).

parameters.name: Cathode Electronic Conductivity
parameters.description: Effective electronic conductivity via LSCF network.

parameters.name: Chemical Expansion Coeff
parameters.description: Chemical expansion coefficient due to stoichiometry changes.

parameters.name: CTE (Crofer)
parameters.description: Thermal expansion coefficient of Crofer 22 APU.

parameters.name: Connectivity Metrics
parameters.description: Largest cluster fractions per solid phase (derived).
